note: Starter list of first-party vendor, standards, research-tool and news domains that threat reports cite but that are not themselves indicators. A matching domain is kept as reference_only and never enters a detection list. Shared hosting, CDN and code-hosting domains that attackers abuse (for example amazonaws.com, github.io, cloudfront.net, pastebin.com) are deliberately NOT listed. Review before the formal experiment; the report publisher's own domain is added per source at run time.
